Personal Spa Experience at Your Fingertips Aromatherapy & Phytonutrient Infused Bathing Salts 

The Y on Earth Community  has established a very special supporting partnership with  Wele Waters . 

Wele Waters is gifting jars of its healing phytonutrient rich aromatherapy soaking salts to supporters of the Y on Earth Community who join the Monthly Giving Program. 

This win/win/win arrangement – an example of circular and regenerative economy – is a wonderful way to enhance your self-care and personal wellbeing practice, while also supporting the Y on Earth Community’s mobilization work for climate action, soil regeneration and culture of kindness. 

Not only does the monthly shipment from Wele Waters give you a gentle reminder to maintain your soaking ceremony self-care practice,  an extra jar or two on hand also serve as great gifts for birthday parties and special events. 

Support the Y on Earth Community 
With your Monthly Giving contribution AND enhance your well-being practice!

Join this special Monthly Giving Program offer and you’ll receive: 

Monthly shipment of one Wele Waters jar of your choice at the $33+/month level 
3-pack at the $88+/month level 
Monthly shipment of the Premium Pack  5-pack at the $133+/month level

Order Today 

Hemp Flower Hemp Flower has been cultivated since biblical times for its wholesome array of naturally occurring phytonutrients, which are known to have dozens of healing and therapeutic properties. They were likely used in the sacred anointing oils of the Old Testament, and are especially sought out for their pain and stress relieving healing powers. 

Rosemary & Pine Rosemary ( R. officinalis ) is traditionally known to be mind-clearing, energizing, memory enhancing, mentally stimulating, and also great for cold and flu relief, sinus decongestion, bronchitis, circulatory stimulation, and breath-expansion. Pine ( P. sylvestris ) is traditionally known to increase metabolism, relieve pain, arthritis, and stress. Additionally, it can elevate mood, relieve cold and cough symptoms, and is an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and is said to help with concentration and memory. [GREAT FOR DAILY SELF CARE]

Eucalyptus Traditionally known to clear the mind, energize, and relieve pain. Eucalyptus ( E. globulus ) is also an expectorant, decongestant, and is known to alleviate symptoms of cold and bronchitis. This reliable go-to product is a “spa in a jar,” - a must have for athletes, weekend warriors and parents. [GREAT FOR DAILY SELF CARE]

Lavender The calming and anxiety reducing qualities of Lavender ( L. angustifolia ) are traditionally known, along with its wound healing, burn relief, cell regeneration, insect bite relief and general skin care benefits. Lavender is an antispasmodic and can relieve itchy skin. [GREAT FOR DAILY SELF CARE]

Aphrodesia Blend With Ylang Ylang and Rose Petal essential oils, this special blend is a must-have for intimate lovers as well as that luscious night home alone. Ylang Ylang ( C. odorata ) is known for its nourishing qualities, to be antidepressant, and is a well-known aphrodisiac. Called the Queen of Essential Oils, Rose ( R. damascene ) is highly sought after for its emotionally nourishing, stress relieving, anxiety reducing, cell regenerating, and aphrodisiac qualities. [GREAT FOR INTIMATE MOMENTS]

Moontime Blend With Neroli and Rose Geranium, this special blend is a welcome relief for cramps and depletion of women’s monthly cycles. Neroli ( C. aurantium ) is known to relieve PMS symptoms, reduce anxiety, relieve postpartum depression, and is an antidepressant. Rose Geranium ( P. graveolens ) is also known to relieve PMS symptoms, to be antimicrobial, to relieve nerve pain, and is indicated for hormonal imbalance. [GREAT FOR WOMEN’S RELIEF]

Orange Orange ( C. sinensis ) is said to relieve rheumatism, arthritis, and exhaustion, and to be good for kidney and bladder issues. It brings balance and harmony, while enhancing passion, freedom, sexuality, creativity, and intuition. Vanilla ( V. planifolia ) is anti-inflammatory, and may soothe aches, pains, and arthritis, while delighting the senses.

Lemon Lemon ( C. limon ) is energizing, and is said to promote hydration, nourish skin, relieve pain, treat acne, heal wounds, ease morning sickness, and reduce anxiety and depression. Bergamot ( C. bergamia ) is commonly used to elevate mood, alleviate stress, and can relieve pain and ease muscle spasms. Traditional Chinese medicine indicates Bergamot for digestive issues, and it is used to reduce melancholy in Ayurveda. 

Organic Coconut Oil Naturally antibacterial and antifungal, coconut oil is an excellent skin moisturizer as well as a wonderful hair conditioner. Coconut oil ( C. nucifera ) hydrates our skin, is a deep cleanser, protects from sunburn, soothe chapped lips and can even reduce facial wrinkles.

Epsom Salt Known for many healing benefits, Epsom Salt (magnesium sulfate heptahydrate, MgSO4), was first discovered in Epsom Common, south of London, in the late middle ages. Epsom Salt is considered a sleep aid, is a natural exfoliant, is anti-inflammatory, and relieves sore muscles, dry skin and small wounds. 

Achieve well-being in a Jar 

Hot Baths In natural hot springs and wood-heated spas alike, our ancestors all over the world frequently immersed in hot water for the many healing and therapeutic benefits of soaking. From pain relief to muscle toning, hot water stimulates proteins and helps improve circulation, regulate blood sugar, relieves headaches, cleanses the skin (our largest organ!) and even contributes to weight loss! Soaking in hot water (102-104° F, ideally) for 15-20 minutes before bed-time can facilitate deeper, more relaxing, vitalizing and nourishing sleep.
